connector.name: Bun Uia

connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package bun-uia. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.

env.name: BUN_UIA_PROFILE
env.description: Capability profile: 'readonly' (inspect/read only), 'safe' (read + input + window — default), or 'full' (also os + fs tools).

env.name: BUN_UIA_OS
env.description: Set to '1' to allow OS-level tools (launch_app, run_program, open_path) AND filesystem tools (read_file, write_file, list_dir) regardless of profile.

env.name: BUN_UIA_ALLOW
env.description: Comma-separated tool names or categories to additionally allow on top of the profile.

env.name: BUN_UIA_DENY
env.description: Comma-separated tool names or categories to deny, overriding the profile and BUN_UIA_ALLOW.

env.name: BUN_UIA_CURSOR
env.description: Set to 'never' to forbid the real-cursor fallback entirely (strictly cursor-free). By default clicks/drags are cursor-free but fall back to the real hardware cursor when no cursor-free path exists.

env.name: BUN_UIA_FS_ROOT
env.description: Sandbox root directory that read_file/write_file/list_dir are confined to when fs tools are enabled.
